title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot in the Queues app on mobile
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly treats audit and retention coverage as unpublished despite Microsoft's general Copilot rules covering these interactions. It also overstates who can query recordings and says every user needs two separate add-ons without allowing for Copilot included in Microsoft 365 E7. The rollout details and documented control paths are supported.
